overview: Odisha Startup Policy & iStart Odisha is a state-level initiative by the Government of Odisha to foster innovation, support startups, and build a robust entrepreneurial ecosystem through strategic partnerships, policy interventions, and financial incentives. The scheme provides recognition, funding, incubation support, and various benefits to startups operating in the state, with a focus on sectors like Agritech, IT, AI, Healthcare, Fintech, and Biotechnology. It aims to position Odisha among the top startup hubs in India by promoting innovation, skill development, and market access for startups.
objectives: To emerge amongst the top 3 'Startup Hubs' in India by 2020
To unleash the potential of women entrepreneurship in Odisha by encouraging at least 33% of startups with Founders/Co-Founders as women
To build a holistic Startup ecosystem in Odisha to enable the State to become one of the top three Startup destinations in the country
To implement a supportive regulatory framework and robust governance structure that enables hassle-free, time-bound statutory clearances and monitoring
To develop a world class 'Startup Hub' in Odisha by 2020
To encourage incubators including sector-specific ones aligning with the State’s strengths and requirements
To create enabling environment and supporting eco-system that facilitates at least 1,000 Startups in next five years in the state
To create a strong institutional framework for effective implementation, monitoring and evaluation of this initiative
eligibility: The registration by a startup entity for recognition can be done online by simply filling a Startup Registration Form and giving self-certification for the following set of documents: 1. Incorporation certificate of the entity (verified from MCA-21 portal). 2. Self-certification for Startup definition: The date of its incorporation/registration is not prior to 7 years (10 years for Biotechnology Startups). The entity’s annual turnover does not exceed Rs.25 Crore for any preceding financial year. If not registered in Odisha, the entity employs at least 50% of its total qualified workforce in Odisha. The entity is not an extension of the existing family business; or formed by splitting up or reconstruction of a business already in existence. 3. Self-Certification for Proof of innovation: DIPP Startup India recognition certificate; OR Startup has a patent filed in the entity name and published in the Journal by the India Patent Office in areas affiliated with the nature of business being promoted; OR Sanction Letter of funding/grant to the entity by Government of India or any State Government as part of any specified scheme to promote innovation; OR Letter of funding of not less than 20 percent in equity by any Incubation Fund/Angel Fund/Private Equity Fund/Accelerator/Angel Network duly registered with SEBI that endorses innovative nature of the business; OR If an entity does not possess any of the above mentioned four documents, it may submit a one page write-up/note explaining the innovative nature of its product. The applicant entity is encouraged to share its business plan along with the note on innovation.
benefits: Monthly allowance of Rs.20,000 (Rs.22,000/- if the startup Founder(s)/Co-Founder(s) are Women or transgender or from Social Categories such as SC/ST/SEBC/PH, with at least 50% equity), which may be provided for a period of one year if the startup fulfills any of the following conditions: total equity financing by SEBI registered AIF Category 1 & 2 fund or Angel Networks in the range of Rs. 5 Lakh to Rs. 1.00 Crore; or has a patent filed in the entity name and published in the Journal by the India Patent Office in areas affiliated with the nature of business being promoted; or has a sanction letter of funding/grant to the entity by Government of India or any State Government; or has a revenue run rate of Rs. 50 thousand to Rs. 10 Lakh per month over the last three months at least. Product Development and Marketing/Publicity assistance up to Rs. 15 lakh (Upto Rs.16 lakhs if the startup Founder(s)/Co-Founder(s) is Woman or transgender or from Social Categories such as SC/ST/SEBC/PH, with at least 50% equity), which may be given to a 'recognized' Startup entity for introduction of innovated product in the market if it fulfills any of the following conditions: total equity financing by SEBI registered AIF Category 1 & 2 fund or Angel Networks of at least Rs. 25 Lakh; or Sanction Letter of funding/grant to the entity by Government of India or any State Government of at least Rs. 5 Lakh; or the startup has got a revenue run rate of Rs. 2.5 Lakh per month over last six months at least. Need based assistance towards cost of raw material/components and other related equipments required for the innovative process for new product development/existing product improvement, provided only in case(s) where innovation is dependent on specific raw material/equipment and subject to approval by the Startup Council. Financial Support for event Participation: financial support to state recognized Startups for participating in reputed national and international events, where they are representing the state (support may include economy class air fare or 3 tier AC train fare for travel & free space in the stall, if set up by State Government). Subsidised Incubation: Recognised startups may avail subsidy benefit to the extent of 50% of monthly rental of the incubation space (subject to a maximum of Rs. 5000) for a period of maximum one year, if getting incubated at any of the incubators recognised by the Startup Odisha Initiative. Additional benefits to Women led Startups: Monthly allowance shall be Rs.22,000/-, if the startup Founder(s)/Co-Founder(s) are Women or transgender or from Social Categories such as SC/ST/SEBC/PH (with at least 50% equity). Up-to Rs.16 lakhs towards product development and marketing/publicity assistance, if the startup Founder(s)/Co-Founder(s) is Woman or transgender or from Social Categories such as SC/ST/SEBC/PH (with at least 50% equity). Benefits to Incubators: One-Time Capital Grant of 50% of the capital cost (excluding the cost of building) up to a maximum of Rs.1 crore, which may be given to an approved incubator to set up or scale up incubation facility. In case, a university recognised under the Central/State Act is able to raise funding for development of its incubation infrastructure, the Startup Council may consider providing a matching grant subject to an upper limit of Rs.5 crore on case-to-case basis. Such grant from the government shall only be used for development of incubation infrastructure including purchase of equipment for the incubation facility. Reimbursement of Utility Expense of Rs.1 lakh per year for a period of 3 years, which may be provided to an approved incubator for providing free internet, free electricity and free mentoring services to the incubatees. This benefit will not be available to virtual incubators. Performance capital grant of Rs.5 lakhs, which may be given to an approved incubator for its each successful Startup incubated at least for a minimum period of 3 months.
financial_support: The Fund of Funds Scheme with a target corpus of Rs 100 Crore will be disbursed over 5 years to support 5,000 Startups in the State. The scheme money is to be invested in selected funds with an agreement of minimum availability at 1:1 ratio to the state registered startups within 5 years. The scheme budget to be drawn from the treasury and shall be utilized as grants periodically. Similarly, the returns from these to be reinvested in strengthening the ecosystem. A high powered advisory committee led by developmental commissioner and principal secretaries of various departments like MSME, Finance, Skill Development etc. as members to monitor and take decisions periodically viz. Execution of the scheme, Eligibility guidelines, selection as well as exit from partner funds. Through this Scheme, Startup’s will be getting multiple collateral benefits, investment opportunities & also the employment avenue for youths shall be broadened by aiding the Enterprises.
application_process: 1. Register on startupodisha.gov.in 2. Fill Startup Registration Form with self-certification for incorporation, startup definition, and proof of innovation 3. Upload Incorporation certificate (verified from MCA-21 portal) 4. Submit and await approval by Nodal Agency within 2 weeks 5. Nodal Agency forwards to Startup Secretariat collates certified applications and presents to Task Force for consideration and final approval 6. Result published online and emailed to the concerned Startup entity 7. A startup applicant can reapply for startup recognition/financial assistance one more time after a gap of 3 months from the date of communication of rejection 8. Once recognized, apply online for monetary benefit by filling a standard form 9. Nodal Agency reviews monetary application and shares review with Startup Secretariat within next 2 weeks 10. Startup Secretariat collates applications, undertakes due diligence, presents to Task Force/Startup Council for consideration and final approval within next 2 weeks 11. Result published online and emailed to the concerned Startup entity 12. Once approved by the Task Force, Startup receives the monetary benefit(s) directly in the entity’s bank account
required_documents: Self-certification for Proof of innovation (DIPP Startup India recognition certificate; OR patent filed in entity name and published in Journal by India Patent Office; OR Sanction Letter of funding/grant by Govt. of India or any State Govt.; OR Letter of funding of not less than 20 percent in equity by SEBI registered Incubation Fund/Angel Fund/Private Equity Fund/Accelerator/Angel Network; OR one page write-up/note explaining innovative nature of product)
Business plan along with note on innovation (encouraged)
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round.
caveats: Monthly allowance payment for the first three months may be made directly to a recognized eligible startup entity in its registered bank account on a monthly basis; three months onwards, payment may be released based on the utilization report submitted by the Startup online to the Nodal agency within 15 days of completion of the first three months
Payment of the monthly allowance will be made for a period of one year only; Startup entity can avail this benefit only once
Startup entity shall submit a final utilization certificate highlighting utilization of the monthly allowance along with supporting documents and bills within one month of the completion of 1 year

Product Development and Marketing / Publicity Assistance: Startup will have to submit a self-contained product development plan with justification online; Subject to approval, 50% of the payment to a recognized startup entity may be made in advance and the remaining 50% will be made to its registered bank account upon utilization of the advance payment on the basis of submission of utilization certificate along with bills; The Startup entity must submit utilization certificate along with bills for the advance payment within three months of receiving the grant; The Startup entity must submit final utilization certificate along with bills for the entire amount within six months of release of grant

Need based Assistance: Startup entity will have to submit a self-contained plan with justification online for the need and the manner of utilization of the assistance; Subject to approval, payment may be made directly to a recognized startup in its registered bank account; The Startup entity must submit utilization certificate along with bills for all the expenses within three months of receiving the grant

Benefits to Incubators: One-Time Capital Grant: The approved aspiring/existing incubator will submit online application for Monetary Grant to the Startup Secretariat and upload requisite documents for due diligence; The grant may be disbursed in a phased manner as per the budget/utilisation plan submitted by the incubator and approved by the Startup Council; The grant may be disbursed in proportion to the funds brought in by the approved incubator, as mentioned in their budget plan and approved by the Startup Council

Reimbursement of Utility Expense: One-time payment of utility expenses limiting to Rs. 1 lakh per year for a maximum period of 3 years may be made directly to the approved existing incubator in its registered bank account; The incubator must submit bills for the expenses while availing the grant and submit utilization certificate within 3 months of the release of the grant

Performance capital grant: One-time payment may be made directly to the approved incubator in its registered bank account; The approved incubator will submit a list of the successful incubatees incubated at least for a period of three months
